SPECIALIST INSURTECH INVESTORS

Insurtech Gateway has deep knowledge of insurance, venture building and regulation. As active insurtech investors, we provide hands-on support through our authorised incubators and angel network to validate ideas, and invest from our institutional funds to fuel growth.

We’ve created a place where exceptional Pre-Seed and Seed-stage founding teams can build best-in-class businesses in partnership with insurers, brokers, regulators, and investors.

Together, we can accelerate innovation, de-risk execution, and pilot transformative ideas.

WHAT DRIVES US AS INSURTECH INVESTORS

Insurance is being rebuilt from the ground up. Data, software, and AI are converging with this centuries-old industry to redefine how risk is measured, mitigated, and managed.

This shift is opening new frontiers – smarter products fuelling growth in emerging sectors, and new forms of protection reaching communities who’ve never had it before. Behind the scenes, technology is improving decision-making and automating manual tasks.

At Insurtech Gateway, we back the founders leading this change.

BONDAVAL
BONDAVAL. YOUR WORD. OUR BOND.
THE SMARTEST WAY TO COVER CREDIT RISK

Credit managers seeking to cover their exposure to their buyers have so far been stuck with a small range of analogue, imperfect tools. Bondaval‘s technology-enabled insurance products are able to replace any of these tools in one place, while offering more complete, flexible cover, all delivered through the Bondaval platform.

Powered by Bondaval proprietary data engine, risks can be underwritten at scale, while feeding insights back to both insurers and credit managers.

Insurtech Gateway led their $1.64m Pre-Seed round in January 2021, following on when they raised a $7m Seed round in October 2021 and $15m Series A in December 2022.

PROBLEM

Securing credit risk either involves significant balance sheet impact for the counterparties being covered, or uncertainty on the part of the beneficiary seeking cover. Existing solutions from banks and traditional credit insurers are often slow, opaque, and cover can be cancelled with little warning.

SOLUTION

Bondaval’s range of products combine more complete, A-rated cover with a powerful technology platform to give credit managers more transparency and control over the risk they are covering, while releasing the constraints on counterparties posting security.

BONDAVAL FOUNDERS

Tom Powell (CEO) – 5 years experience with surety-related products. 2 years working in an early-stage tech venture. 1 year working at a Bio-Tech start-up. Prior to business, Tom was a professional sportsman and England captain in 2 Commonwealth Games and Rugby Sevens World Cup.

Sam Damoussi (COO) – 10 years experience as a surety and growth specialist in insurance-backed bonds. Established and launched two prior A-rated, fuel bond programs both as MGA and insurer. Previously at an independent Lloyds broker and CNA.

“Without the support of Insurtech Gateway, there might not have been a Bondaval. By sponsoring us as an Appointed Representative under their FCA license, Insurtech Gateway gave us the regulatory support we needed to start operating immediately: the equivalent of a two-year head start. Now, their guidance has helped us to navigate the process and become directly authorised with the FCA ourselves. They have been invaluable champions of the business, and their continued support is greatly appreciated.”

Tom Powell, CEO at Bondaval

KLAIMY
KLAIMY, MEDICAL INSURANCE AI AUTOMATION
OPTIMISING WORKFLOWS

Klaimy, a Paris based SaaS business, is streamlining operational processes in medical underwriting and claims processing.

Powered by advanced Large Language Models (LLM) technology, Klaimy’s solution helps brokers and insurers automate the extraction of data from both structured and unstructured documents. 

Insurtech Gateway led Klaimy’s £1m Pre-Seed round in October 2024.

PROBLEM

Medical underwriting and claims processing often involve handling vast amounts of complex, unstructured data from documents like medical reports and bills. Manually extracting and interpreting this information is time-consuming, prone to errors, and delays decision-making. This creates inefficiencies for insurers and brokers, leading to longer processing times and increased costs.

SOLUTION

Klaimy’s AI-powered platform automates the extraction of data from both structured and unstructured documents, significantly reducing manual effort. By leveraging LLM, Klaimy quickly processes complex information, providing brokers and insurers with accurate, real-time insights. This streamlines workflows, reduces errors, and speeds up underwriting and claims decisions.

KLAIMY FOUNDERS

Amira Nakouri (CEO) – Amira has over seven years of strategy consulting experience, leading digital transformation projects for insurers, including claims processing. Her deep industry knowledge positions her to drive Klaimy’s growth and address the operational inefficiencies insurers face.

Yazid Hadni (CPO) – Yazid, with a Master’s in Statistical and Financial Engineering, developed an underwriting automation tool for La Mutuelle Générale. His experience in AI-driven document processing and venture capital strengthens Klaimy’s focus on scalable, automated insurance solutions.

Juan Barragan (CTO) – Juan has 15 years of experience in AI, machine learning, and software engineering. A second time startup co-founder, his expertise in scalable AI systems directly supports Klaimy’s development of innovative, AI-powered solutions.

“We’re thrilled to work with Insurtech Gateway as they understand both the potential and the real-world impact of our technology. With their support, we’re able to refine and scale our platform to meet insurers’ growing needs for efficiency and accuracy in claims and underwriting workflows. This partnership is instrumental as we continue our mission to transform data processing in the insurance sector.”

Amira Nakouri, CEO at Klaimy

NOVEE AI
NOVEE, AI INTELLIGENCE LAYER
REIMAGINING UNDERWRITING

Novee AI is the AI intelligence layer transforming how trillions of dollars in insurance risk is assessed and underwritten. Behind every plane, power plant or vessel lies a complex web of decisions that keep the world running, yet these decisions are still driven by manual processes and gut feel. Underwriters spend hours trawling through fragmented documents and emails to understand and assess complex risks. Novee exists to reimagine how these risks are assessed, enabling a faster, more data-driven and consistent approach to underwriting.

Insurtech Gateway participated in Novee’s £1.6m round led by 42Cap in July 2025.

PROBLEM

Commercial and specialty underwriters are burdened by manual, repetitive tasks that consume time and limit their ability to write new business. They spend up to half their time piecing together fragmented information from documents and emails, often relying on gut feel over structured, data-driven insights. This limits speed, consistency, and capacity.

SOLUTION

Novee solves this differently. It understands the full submission—regardless of format—and applies each team’s unique risk logic, captured in natural language and updated in real time. Submissions are assessed instantly, with actionable insights (with citations) surfaced directly in existing systems. Captured data flows through workflows, automating tasks and powering real-time pipeline and portfolio analytics.

NOVEE FOUNDERS

Haris Khan (CEO) – Haris previously worked at Deloitte, delivering AI underwriting projects for carriers across the London Market. He also founded an AI startup focused on providing granular property data from aerial and street-view imagery to underwriters.

Arved Pohlabeln (CPO) – Arved also worked at Deloitte, delivering AI underwriting projects for carriers across the London Market. He has deep expertise in the Lloyd’s Market, having led the definition of key data standards—streamlining and modernising the market.

Ehsan Ziya (CTO) – Ehsan has built and managed AI systems and products at scale. He understands the insurance market and the functional aspects of processes—a competitive edge when building AI systems.

“We’re looking forward to tapping into Insurtech Gateway’s deep insurance expertise and their network across the market. Their experience supporting early-stage ventures will be invaluable as we scale and embed our technology with leading insurers”

Haris Khan, CEO at Novee
